treaty_name: Convention between the Kingdom of Norway and the Republic of Kenya for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income and capital (1972, with Protocol)
eif_quote: Lovdata metadata: "Avtalens ikrafttredelsesdato 10-09-1973" | Art. 30(1): "This Convention shall come into force on the date when the last of all such things shall have been done in Kenya and Norway as are necessary to give the Convention the force of law in Kenya and Norway respectively, and shall thereupon have effect; (a) in respect of income arising for the year of income 1972 and subsequent years;"
source_title: Overenskomster med fremmede stater 1973 (official Norwegian treaty series), Convention Norway-Kenya 1972 with Protocol, English text (done in English only), National Library of Norway scan, OCR read via nb.no API. Lovdata holds metadata only.

rates.quote: (a) 15 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends if the recipient is a company which owns at least 25 per cent of the voting shares of the company paying the dividends during the period of six months immediately preceding the date of payment of the dividends;
(b) 25 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases.

2. However, such interest may be taxed in the Contracting State in which it arises, and according to the laws of that State; if it is so taxed the tax charged in the Contracting State in which the interest arises shall not exceed 20 per cent of the gross amount of the interest.

2. However, such royalties may be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise, and according to the laws of that State; if they are so taxed the tax charged in the Contracting State in which the royalties arise shall not exceed 20 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties.

ppt.basis: none (not MLI-covered: Kenya lists Norway but Norway does not list Kenya; no PPT in the Convention)

notes: Dividend 15% tier: recipient company owning >=25% of the voting shares during the six months immediately preceding payment (recorded as 183 days, approximation of "six months"); 25% otherwise. Art. 10(3)-(4): Norwegian exemption of Kenyan dividends under Norwegian participation rules / by mutual agreement (residence-side relief, not modelled). Art. 11(3): interest paid to the other Government, political subdivisions, local authorities, central bank or wholly owned agencies exempt at source (not modelled). Interest 20%, royalties 20% (definition includes equipment rentals). Effective retroactively for income of the year of income 1972 (Art. 30(1)); replaced the 1951 Norway-UK arrangement as extended to Kenya. Not MLI-covered.
